removed: We disclose the contents of your account to law enforcement only when required to do so by a valid court order or search warrant.
added: We may disclose the contents of your account in response to lawful requests from government authorities, including to meet national security or law enforcement requirements.

bullets.text: The bar for handing account contents to authorities dropped from requiring a court order or search warrant to any 'lawful request' from government authorities.
